annotations.text: Labelled kicker, no chevron. One strip, one line at a time: kicker reads TIP OF THE DAY or QUOTE OF THE DAY depending on what is showing. Advances on every return to home and on tap.
Settings > Appearance > Home tips: toggle Tips on/off, toggle Quotes on/off, edit the tip list and the quote list (one per line, plain text), reset either list to default. Both off = strip hidden.
